messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert: increased tail latency detected for canary deployment rwd-cano-v3. New model variant rwd-cano-v3 was rolled to 10% traffic at 17:14 UTC; p99 jumped above SLO in us-west-2. Auto-escalation to on-call.
oncall_sre_maya: ACK — paging in. I'm looking at the all-requests p95/p99 dashboard now. p95 is ~750ms, p99 is ~12.8s and climbing. Metrics window: 17:12–17:18 UTC.
ml_eng_zoe: seeing the same — streaming stalls on the incremental-chunk path. A subset of requests show KV cache miss storms and many TLS rehandshakes. Possible model change in the attention implementation causing slower step time.
eng_platform_esther: Can we pin the canary back to 0% while we triage? If rollback is needed we need an operator.
oncall_sre_maya: Esther, can you start a rollback plan? I'll coordinate mitigation and customer communications.
eng_platform_esther: Starting rollback prep. Command I'm going to run:
```
# revert canary weight
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --deployment rwd-cano-v3 --weight 0 --region us-west-2
# fallback to previous variant
redwoodctl activate --model rwd-stable-v2 --region us-west-2
```
prod_sam: FYI, two paying customers reported increased latency errors in telemetry (support ticket ids: 5452, 5460). Not yet full 5xx, mostly timeouts in client SDK at 10s.
customer_ops_lee: Noted — informing impacted accounts with "investigating" and ETA TBD.
ml_eng_zoe: Quick check — tail logs show repeated errors like: `StreamWriter.send_chunk timeout` and `kv_cache_lookup: miss_concurrency=48`. That concurrency seems high for a 10% canary. I'm pulling a sample trace now.
infra_jake: Also seeing connection churn to the model pod set. pod restarts: 3 in the last 6 minutes (OOM not present), but CPU spikes to 90% on those pods during the stalls.
oncall_sre_maya: Looks like a traffic pattern amplification. Could be a batching mismatch under the new model kernel. Two immediate mitigations: 1) set canary weight 0% (rollback), 2) enable per-route hard timeouts and short-circuit streaming for affected customers. Which do we do first?
eng_platform_esther: I'll set weight=0 now. Running the command and will post logs.
```
# now
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --deployment rwd-cano-v3 --weight 0 --region us-west-2 && echo "done"
```
eng_platform_esther: done — canary weight set to 0 at 17:20:03 UTC. Traffic should start shifting back to rwd-stable-v2.
ml_eng_zoe: After weight drop, I'm watching the request tail. p99 is already trending down from ~12.8s to ~4.5s within one minute.
oncall_sre_maya: Good. Estimating customer impact: ~3 customers impacted with >10s timeouts, ~1.7k requests/min in canary region during window. Recorded incident as Sev2 for now.
prod_sam: Logged customer notifications and escalated to account owners.
eng_platform_esther: Activation to rwd-stable-v2 completed successfully. No rollback artifacts.
ml_eng_zoe: Saved traces and a sample problematic request: trace id 0x7f9a3b — shows repeated reserializing of KV context and backpressure on the attention kernel at step 512. Suspect change in kernel scheduling introduced during compile.
infra_jake: Pod CPU normalized after traffic shift. No pod crashes after shift.
oncall_sre_maya: Confirm final metrics (17:30 UTC window): p95 680ms, p99 860ms. Back within SLO. Marking incident as mitigated.
prod_sam: :white_check_mark: Customers updated; support tickets updated to waiting-on-root-cause.
ml_eng_zoe: Next actions I'm proposing: 1) block further rollouts of rwd-cano-v3 until we reproduce locally, 2) run canary on smaller ingress concurrency and with KV cache pre-warm, 3) add a rollback gate that triggers if p99 > 3s for 3 consecutive minutes.
oncall_sre_maya: Agreed. I'll own the immediate post-incident follow-up and coordinate an RCA doc. Zoe, can you include traces and diff of the attention kernel compile options?
ml_eng_zoe: Yep, I'll attach traces and compile flags. Also will run the model in a perf sandbox with stress traffic to validate.
eng_platform_esther: I'll add an automated abort in the rollout pipeline: if p99 crosses threshold during canary, set weight->0 automatically and notify.
customer_ops_lee: I'll schedule a customer post-mortem note for impacted accounts.
prod_sam: Handoff: Maya -> Esther for rollout pipeline updates; Maya -> Zoe for RCA; Sam -> Lee for customer comms. Anyone taking ownership of the postmortem writeup?
noncall_sre_maya: I'll start the postmortem draft in #postmortems and tag folks.
ml_eng_zoe: Adding one more note: we should run a compatibility test of kernel variations across the exact hardware SKU used in us-west-2; the issue didn't appear in ci perf where we used different GPU setup.
eng_platform_esther: Got it. I'll record the hardware SKUs and add to the rollout checklist.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: 1770004321 — mitigated (canary weight reverted). Postmortem owner: oncall_sre_maya.
noncall_sre_maya: Closing thread here; if anything recurs reopen. Thanks all. :pray:
